title: From Transcription to Live Music: Gemini's Audio Stack — Thor Schaeff, Google DeepMind

primary.label: Multimodal & Realtime Systems

domains.label: General Purpose
domains.rationale: The talk's primary focus is on multimodal and realtime systems including audio understanding, speech generation, real-time video/audio interaction via Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, and music generation via Lyria 3. The content spans general-purpose multimodal AI capabilities, developer-facing platforms (Gemini API, Google AI Studio), and creative media production (voice generation, music generation). Discussed models are released and available in production while developers are encouraged to experiment through Google AI Studio. Requires familiarity with APIs and AI concepts but remains accessible to developers new to multimodal systems. A conference presentation featuring live demonstrations of audio, speech, and music generation capabilities. Eight direct transcript evidence anchors with said_in_transcript grade support the key claims.

summary: Thor Schaeff, who works on developer experience for the Gemini API and Google AI Studio at Google DeepMind, surveys what DeepMind has been building in AI audio. He frames Gemini 3's audio understanding as the foundation for everything else: models that deeply comprehend, richly transcribe, and robustly reason through audio across languages, dialects, accents, and modalities, including overlapping speech and mid-utterance language switching. The Echo Script demo shows one API call to Gemini 3 Flash Preview returning speaker labels by name, accurate timestamps, language identification, English translation for non-English segments, emotion classification, and a full summary, all via a structured response schema, illustrated with Thor's multilingual self-introductions in English, German, French, Japanese, and Mandarin. Speech generation differs from traditional TTS providers that expose large voice libraries: Gemini offers roughly thirty base voices directed via a 'director's note' — an audio profile, scene setting, performance guidance, sample context, and transcript — because the underlying audio understanding lets the model know what accents and scenarios sound like. Demos include an Irish-accented character built from a standard American base voice and a Singaporean-accented delivery. Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is a full-duplex, sound-to-sound, real-time multimodal model ingesting text, audio, and video via WebSocket and returning real-time audio plus a text transcript, with reasoning baked directly into the audio model rather than cascaded through a separate LLM. A live demo shows the model seeing Thor through video ingestion (max 1 fps), commenting on his outfit in an Irish accent, and reciting a German poem — with the Irish accent carrying over into German, illustrating that system instructions need tuning per language. Developer resources include Python and JavaScript examples in the docs and Gemini coding agent skills for all Gemini APIs. Finally, Lyria 3 is introduced as a music generation model with two variants: Lyria 3 Clip for 30-second jingle generation and Lyria 3 Pro for full-length songs with lyrics. The Live Jukebox demo shows the real-time Gemini Live model calling Lyria via tool use to generate a German techno Schlager about the UK startup scene, live on stage, after conversational negotiation of style and lyrics with the user.
whyItMatters: The talk connects its engineering abstractions, implementation choices, and AI/product implications into one practical system view.
temporalContext: Transcript claims reflect the publication date; linked external context was checked at the run's research date.
takeaways: Gemini 3 Flash Preview can extract speaker-by-name labels, timestamps, language identification, English translation, emotion tags, and a summary from audio in a single API call using structured outputs.
Audio understanding is the foundation: it enables richer transcription, accent-directed speech generation, and real-time conversation.
Gemini speech generation uses ~30 base voices guided by a 'director's note' instead of a large catalogue of prebuilt voices.
Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is a full-duplex, sound-to-sound, real-time multimodal model with reasoning baked into the audio model rather than cascaded through a separate LLM.
Video can be ingested alongside audio in Gemini 3.1 Flash Live at a maximum frame rate of 1 fps via WebSocket; screen ingestion is also supported.
Lyria 3 offers two music generation models: Lyria 3 Clip (30-second jingles) and Lyria 3 Pro (full-length songs with lyrics).
The Gemini Live model can call Lyria via tool use to generate music on request, as demonstrated by the Live Jukebox app producing a German techno Schlager about the UK startup scene.
Google AI Studio lets developers try these models for free without a credit card; demos like Echo Script and the Voice Library are in its gallery.
Gemini coding agent skills are published for all Gemini APIs including the Live API, helping coding agents handle real-time audio development.
Gemma 4 open models now include on-device audio understanding.

sections.title: Intro and DeepMind Audio Releases
sections.summary: Thor introduces himself (with multilingual greetings prepared for a later demo) and recaps recent DeepMind releases: Gemini 3, Gemma 4 open models with on-device audio understanding, video 3.1 light, and Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, a full-duplex sound-to-sound real-time conversational model.

sections.title: Audio Understanding and Echo Script Demo
sections.summary: Audio understanding is framed as the foundation: models that deeply comprehend, richly transcribe, and robustly reason across languages, dialects, accents, and modalities, including overlapping speech. The Echo Script demo shows one API call to Gemini 3 Flash Preview returning speaker-by-name labels, timestamps, language, English translation, emotion, and a summary via structured outputs, illustrated with Thor's multilingual self-introductions.

sections.title: Speech Generation with Director's Note
sections.summary: Unlike traditional TTS providers with large voice catalogues, Gemini offers ~30 base voices directed via a director's note (audio profile, scene, performance guidance, context, transcript). Demos show a standard American base voice transformed into an Irish accent (Finian in a County Clare pub) and a Singaporean accent (chicken rice at a hawker center), powered by the same audio understanding.

sections.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live
sections.summary: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live is a full-duplex, sound-to-sound, real-time multimodal model ingesting text, audio, and video via WebSocket and returning real-time audio plus a text transcript. Reasoning is baked into the audio model rather than cascaded through a separate LLM. It is available to try for free at ai.studio/live with system instructions and live camera input.

sections.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Demo and Developer Resources
sections.summary: The live demo continues with the Irish-accented model seeing Thor through video, commenting on his outfit, and reciting a German poem — with the Irish accent carrying over into German, illustrating the need to adjust system instructions per language. Video and screen ingestion is capped at 1 fps. Thor points developers to Python and JavaScript examples in the docs and recommends installing Gemini coding agent skills for all Gemini APIs including the Live API, since real-time audio development can be challenging.

sections.title: Lyria 3 Music Generation and Live Jukebox Demo
sections.summary: Thor introduces Lyria 3, a music generation model with two variants: Lyria 3 Clip for 30-second jingle generation and Lyria 3 Pro for full-length songs with lyrics. The Live Jukebox demo brings everything together: the real-time Gemini Live model acts as a radio DJ, converses with the user about style preferences, and calls Lyria via tool use to generate a German techno Schlager about the UK startup scene, live on stage.
